purpose: Teach: 特急/合戦/乗り物/ヘルメット/反則/力士/バスケットボール/ハイキング

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、特急、絶対、で、絶対、来たの?本気で
lines.en: Riku — did you seriously take the express train all the way here?
lines.style: Quick, playful skepticism with a lift at the end. Teasing but genuinely curious. Lean into the absurdity of the question.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、ゲームの、絶対、合戦、絶対、シーン、絶対、ヤバいぜ、桜
lines.en: That game battle scene is seriously insane, Sakura.
lines.style: Bright energy, building momentum. Lean hard on 「ヤバい」 with genuine enthusiasm. Quick, unguarded — this is what he actually thinks.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、新しい、絶対、乗り物、絶対、好きだよね
lines.en: You really do love anything new with wheels, don't you?
lines.style: Dry observation wrapped in fondness. Steady pace, almost conversational. A small smile in the delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、自転車の、絶対、ヘルメット、絶対、絶対、つけろよ、桜
lines.en: Seriously though — wear your helmet when you're on that bike, okay?
lines.style: Shifts to actual concern underneath the casual tone. Slower, more direct. Says her name to land it. Cares, but won't make it sappy.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、試合で、本気で、絶対、反則、絶対、取られたの?本気で
lines.en: Did you actually get called for a foul during the match?
lines.style: Concerned curiosity, genuine. Slower pace, checking in. The question itself is caring — she wants to know what happened.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、テレビで、絶対、力士、絶対、見たぜ、桜
lines.en: I saw a sumo wrestler on TV yesterday and thought of you.
lines.style: Light, playful. Small laugh underneath. Quick delivery, like he's pleased with the joke. Warm, not mean.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、バスケットボール、絶対、得意だよね
lines.en: You're actually pretty good at basketball, aren't you?
lines.style: Genuine observation, no performance. Straightforward, matter-of-fact. She's stating something true about him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、ハイキング、絶対、行こうぜ、桜
lines.en: Come on, let's go hiking sometime, yeah?
lines.style: Open, inviting energy. Light momentum forward. Casual but actual invitation — he wants her to say yes. Warmth, not pressure.
